title: YETI Rambler Stainless Steel Vacuum Insulated Tumbler with MagSlider Lid, 20oz

reviews.title: Does what it says
reviews.body: Excellent purchase. Keeps my iced coffee cold for hours. The ice is still there even after 4-5 hours. I like the solid body, no condensation, easy to use magnetic lid.Unfortunately it's not fully water tight. Some water comes out if you shake it. Otherwise i would give it 5 stars.
reviews.author: Melvin

reviews.title: YETI Rambler
reviews.body: Tested the rambler with full/half, hot/cold water.  Quite happy with the ability to maintain the temperature at a certain period of time.  However, slightly disappointed with the security of the lid cover.  Tends to see leaking of water at the side when shaken or turned upside down.  Not sure whether is it the lid cover seal/gasket issue?
reviews.author: Low Kian Ming

reviews.title: missing a piece
reviews.body: The rambler is great. But the cover was missing a piece. Cannot keep coffee warm.
reviews.author: CA

reviews.title: check for magslider
reviews.body: Product was sent without the black magslider to me, and I had to return it
reviews.author: Kenneth Lim

reviews.title: NOT leak proof
reviews.body: After reading rave reviews, i decided to get this tumbler even though it was on the pricier side. However it is NOT leak proof. Huge disappointment as it was the only thing i wanted so that i could throw it into bags and not have to worry about spills. I would have gotten replacement lids instead and even if it still isn’t leak proof, it won’t be as costly as this. It does however keep drinks warm or cold for long hours.
reviews.author: Kh

reviews.title: No very effective in keeping cold
reviews.body: Keeps cold for less than marketed
reviews.author: Alwyn Woon

reviews.title: My new daily mug (great for hot or cold drinks!)
reviews.body: Honestly, not sure what I did before I had this tumbler. It looks great, holds temperature well and is surprisingly easy to clean (just chuck it in the dishwasher and it comes out spot loss). It’s not leakproof, but it’s not marketed as such, so no complaints there. The magnetic, removable MagSlider lid is genuinely useful and pops off easily for washing. I was a bit worried about the size at first, but it’s actually really comfortable to hold and doesn’t feel bulky or heavy at all.It works just as well for hot drinks as it does for cold ones, whether that’s a morning coffee or something chilled like a beer or cocktail. Easy to drink from too, it feels more like using a regular mug than a travel cup, which makes it a joy to use daily. Solid bit of kit and definitely one of those things you end up using more than you expect, and of course it makes a great gift!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United Kingdom on 23 January 2026
reviews.author: Tarzan
